subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A large tree in the city square was said to be older than the city hall.”?
options: A student named Eric visited the shop for a geography project.
A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction.
Finally, engineers redesigned part of the project to protect the roots.
Students studied the issue as part of a civics project.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A student named Eric visited the shop for a geography project.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Finally, engineers redesigned part of the project to protect the roots.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students studied the issue as part of a civics project.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Finally, engineers redesigned part of the project to protect the roots.」，答案為「Finally, engineers redesigned part of the project to protect the roots.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Finally, engineers redesigned part of the project to protect the roots.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
